modifier.tinkersnewlife.anti_gravity.des: §fForward (technique key C): all creatures within the radius (scaled by curse output & affinity), except the caster, are levitated; each target costs one unit of curse power. Reversal (F): deploy a pressure field - targets resist by body size & max HP (slowness below threshold, crushed blocks / stun / sustained damage above it). Costs curse power per second. Uses a technique slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.anti_gravity.drai: §cOut of curse power - pressure field collapsed
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ten_divide.flavo: Divide into ten; one strike to the heart.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ten_divide.descr: §fForward (technique key C, requires line of sight): divide the target into ten equal parts and summon a golden weak-point orb at the seventh mark (70% height, in front of the target, follows it, lasts 20s). Hitting that orb with any of your damage triggers a crit on the target - damage x crit multiplier (1.3 + output x0.08 + affinity x0.004); the orb shatters after one hit. Pressing C again on a marked target performs a guaranteed precise slash. Uses a technique slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.ten_divide.marked: §6Weak point carved on %s: strike the golden orb to crit once
modifier.tinkersnewlife.mixu_gelong.flav: Wrapped in a cocoon, still as a mountain.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.mixu_gelong.desc: §fNew Shadow Style - Mikoshi Kago (skill, uses a skill slot): passively activates while trapped in an enemy domain - you are frozen (no techniques, no items, no movement) in exchange for absolute defense against domain effects (including Unlimited Void's stun). Costs 24 curse power/sec; ends when drained.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.luohua.flavor: Blossoms on the wind, body like a dance.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.luohua.descripti: §fNew Shadow Style - Falling Blossom (skill, uses a skill slot): passively activates while trapped in an enemy domain - you may act freely (techniques & items usable, but slow movement) and resist domain effects, §cbut cannot resist Unlimited Void's stun§f. Costs 24 curse power/sec.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.jianyi_lingyu.fl: A small world of your own that turns force aside.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.jianyi_lingyu.de: §fNew Shadow Style - Simple Domain (skill, uses a skill slot): passively activates while trapped in an enemy domain - a small barrier resists domain effects (including Unlimited Void's stun); you can move and use items, §cbut cannot use techniques§f while it lasts. Costs 24 curse power/sec.
message.tinkersnewlife.skill.no_techniqu: §cTechniques are unavailable while Mikoshi Kago / Simple Domain is active
word.tinkersnewlife.ryomen.desc: Target: Ryomen Sukuna - his blaze sears the target and weakens it
word.tinkersnewlife.hastur.desc: Target: The King in Yellow - whispers blind and slow the target
word.tinkersnewlife.poison.desc: Core: Rot him - the target is poisoned
word.tinkersnewlife.explode.desc: Core: Detonate him - cursed blast at the target (no block damage)
word.tinkersnewlife.leech.desc: Core: Drain him - damage the target and heal half of it back
modifier.tinkersnewlife.fuzhu_cisi.flavo: The court is in session; the guilty shall die.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.fuzhu_cisi.descr: §fDeploy the domain on a looked-at target: all creatures inside (except the caster) are frozen - New Shadow techniques are ineffective. The target becomes the defendant: undead are judged guilty after 3s (attack power zeroed for 60s); arthropods are guilty at night, innocent by day; players face a 6s trial (guilty if villager+animal kills exceed 1000). The guilty are executed by the Executioner's Sword (1 durability / 120s / unique): hitting the defendant kills it instantly, other creatures take 200% damage. Guilty players lose, in order, cursed tools -> techniques -> curse power for 60s (escalating each retrial). Uses a domain slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.fuzhu_cisi.open: §dExecution by Verdict - court is open! Defendant: %s
message.tinkersnewlife.fuzhu_cisi.death: Death sentence - carry it out now!
item.tinkersnewlife.execution_sword.desc: §c1 durability, vanishes after 120s. Striking the defendant kills it instantly; other creatures take 200% damage
modifier.tinkersnewlife.taizang_bianye.f: All things to one; all bear the weight.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.taizang_bianye.d: §fDomain expansion: every creature inside (except the caster) is crushed by pressure equal to 2x the Anti-Gravity reversal pressure (scales with curse affinity/output). Targets resist by body size & max HP: slow below threshold, crushed blocks / stun / sustained damage above it. This domain's pressure CAN be resisted by the New Shadow techniques (Mikoshi Kago / Falling Blossom / Simple Domain). Costs radius x30 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
True and false entwined; every art is mine.

§fDomain expansion: you enter a borrowed-technique state - switch freely among every technique you have unlocked in this save's Patchouli guide (switch key cycles the unlocked set; any unlocked technique can be cast instantly). Only while the domain is active: closing/leaving restores the technique selected before expansion. Costs radius x25 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.zhenyan.open: §dZhen Yan Xiang Ai - arts interlinked! %s techniques unlocked in this save - cycle with the switch key
modifier.tinkersnewlife.qianhe_yingyi.fl: Within the shadow court, ten thousand beasts arise.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.qianhe_yingyi.de: §fDomain expansion: forcibly stuns every target inside (except the caster - cannot move; New Shadow techniques CAN resist this domain's stun, like Taizang Bianye - only Execution by Verdict is unstoppable). Then summons ALL ten shadows shikigami x2 (all tamed, scaled by the caster's curse affinity/output) to hunt every target inside the domain. Closing the domain dismisses every summoned shikigami. Costs radius x60 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.qianhe.open: §dQian He Ying Yi Ting - ten thousand beasts arise! %s shikigami summoned
modifier.tinkersnewlife.tie_guan_gai_wei: The iron coffin topples; the mountain burns.

§fDomain expansion: every creature inside (except the caster) is kept on fire, and takes a curse-scorch hit every 5 ticks that ignores invulnerability frames (0.6 + output x0.35 + affinity x0.01 per hit; armor/resistance still applies). This domain CAN be resisted by the New Shadow techniques (like Taizang Bianye - only Execution by Verdict is unstoppable). Costs radius x50 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.tie_guan_gai_wei_: §cTie Guan Gai Wei Shan - the mountain burns! Radius %s
modifier.tinkersnewlife.zi_bi_yuan_dun_g: Touch and transform; life reshaped by hand.

§fDomain expansion: each target inside (except the caster) is transfigured once - mobs are replaced by guardian shikigami of the chosen form (tamed, permanent); players are forcibly morphed for 60s (tools disabled). The form is the caster's Wu Wei selection if set (requires the Wu Wei technique); otherwise random zombie or skeleton. This domain CAN be resisted by the generic grace period and by the New Shadow techniques (like Taizang Bianye - only Execution by Verdict is unstoppable). Costs radius x60 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.zi_bi_yuan_dun_gu: §5Zi Bi Yuan Dun Guo - everyone transforms! Radius %s
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dang_yun_ping_xi: A single boat upon ten thousand waves.

§fDomain expansion: the interior floods with seawater - the caster cannot drown (same-team shikigami/spirits/guards get water breathing too; New Shadow techniques can resist this drowning hazard, like Taizang Bianye - only Execution by Verdict is unstoppable), while other creatures follow normal air rules. The domain keeps a swarm of drowned minions owned by the caster (6 + radius/2, up to 24): they actively hunt every non-allied target inside and attack in melee, refill automatically when killed, ~1/5 carry tridents. Closing the domain restores everything - water vanishes, drowned are dismissed. Costs radius x45 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.dang_yun_ping_xia: §bDang Yun Ping Xian - ten thousand waves! Radius %s
modifier.tinkersnewlife.shi_bao_yue_gong: Moonlight freezes into time-cells; within one palace, every thought halts.

§fDomain expansion: moonlight freezes into time-cells - every target inside (except the caster) is hit by the same standstill stun as a failed Projection Technique (cannot move/attack/use items/turn the view; refreshed every 5 ticks until the domain ends). Players with the Heavenly Restriction - Tyrant body (curse-less pure physical power) are IMMUNE to this domain's stun - the moon's light cannot bind a body without curse. This domain CAN be resisted by the generic grace period and the New Shadow techniques (like Taizang Bianye - only Execution by Verdict is unstoppable). Closing the domain instantly releases everyone inside. Costs radius x55 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.shi_bao_yue_gong_: §dShi Bao Yue Gong Dian - all thoughts halt! Radius %s
Three calamities converge; nothing can be avoided.

§fDomain expansion (guaranteed-hit domain): every projectile the caster fires is steered each tick toward the nearest hostile target inside the domain - even a stray shot curves to hit. Empty left-clicks (swinging at air, at any distance) while holding a Construct technique temp item or a ranged weapon also land a guaranteed strike on the nearest hostile target inside (scaled by the player's attack damage). Targets: every living creature inside except the caster's own team. Costs radius x45 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.san_chong_ji_ku.o: §6San Chong Ji Ku - nothing can be avoided! Radius %s
modifier.tinkersnewlife.yuchuzi.flavor: The stove-fire burns; the blade strikes like fate.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.yuchuzi.descript: §fTechnique Yu Chu Zi - combines Kai / Ba / Zao Kai into one technique (uses a technique slot). Press C to release the current move; press F (reverse key) to cycle Kai -> Ba -> Zao Kai: Kai = a single slash at a looked-at target (70% of the shared base, ignores i-frames, armor still applies); Ba = six slashes at a target within 3 blocks (each half of Kai's damage); Zao Kai = hold C to charge a flame arrow in your main hand, release to fire it (explodes on impact, 200% center damage falling with distance). Curse cost: Kai x1 / Ba x2 / Zao Kai x10 of the base.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.blood_manipulati: Blood as a blade, piercing ten thousand foes.

§fTechnique Blood Manipulation - combines Chuan Xue / Bai Lian / Supernova into one technique (uses a technique slot). Press C to release the current move; press F (reverse key) to cycle Chuan Xue -> Bai Lian -> Supernova: Chuan Xue = spend 5% max HP, fire a blood beam piercing 20 blocks, one hit per target of (1+affinity/100)x(output+blood x5); Bai Lian = spend 7% HP, lock a target by sight, five blood pillars dealing 5 hits (each = Chuan Xue single-target /2); Supernova = spend 10% HP, lock a target by sight, spawn a blood orb that explodes after 0.8s (center damage x blood x10, falling with distance). Ignores i-frames; armor still applies. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.corruption.descr: §7When dealing damage, spend 0.5% of your max soul energy (up to 100 per hit) to amplify the attack: every 5 souls add +0.2 attack damage and +0.05 blocks of knockback (knockback capped at 3 blocks). No effect when souls are insufficient.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.soul_repair.desc: §7Every 20 ticks spend max(1, 6-level) soul energy to restore 1 durability; each restoration has a 5%×level chance to restore 1 additional durability. Max level 3. No effect when souls are insufficient.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dark_metal_break: §7Dealing damage inflicts Weakness I for 2×level seconds; slaying a creature with magic resistance (Resistance effect) has a 45% chance to drop 1 extra Emerald.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dark_metal_magic: §7When taking magic damage, convert 5%×level + 1.5 points of magic damage into physical damage.
item.tinkersnewlife.you_yun.desc: §7Base dmg 10, attack speed 2; every hit breaks shield blocking (like an axe), +120% fixed damage, +10% vs undead; extra knockback (dmg/100 blocks); cannot pierce Infinity.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.soul_eater.flavo: §7Souls as food, the more you sip the richer.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.soul_eater.descr: §7+25% soul energy gain per level; holding level 1 grants an extra +1 soul gain. Max level 3 (level 1 uses 1 upgrade slot; levels 2/3 are slotless).
modifier.tinkersnewlife.pale_plating.des: §7Slotless upgrade: installing costs no slots and grants the tool §e1§7 extra upgrade slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.commander.flavor: §7Command the rabble; strike the foe together.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.commander.descri: §7When you attack a non-illager target, every illager within §e8§7 blocks has a §e30%§7 chance to switch its attack target to the one you are attacking.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.final_brand.flav: §7Sealed with the void, marked for the end.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.final_brand.desc: §7Slotless upgrade: installing costs no slots and grants the tool §e1§7 extra ability slot, but reduces movement speed by §c10%§7.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.blasphemy.flavor: §7Those who defile the gods are forsaken by them.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.blasphemy.descri: §7Slotless upgrade: installing costs no slots and grants the armor §e2§7 extra defense slots, but increases damage taken by §c10%§7.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ex_pierce.flavor: §7The might of five Outer Gods pierces all things.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ex_pierce.descri: §7Upgrade (costs §e1§7 upgrade slot): melee/ranged hits are resolved as piercing damage — ignoring i-frames and piercing through invulnerabilities and damage caps (Wither spawn immunity and half-HP arrow immunity; with Cataclysm installed also its damage caps/out-of-water immunity/phase 2, Mowzie's Ferrous Wroughtnaut invulnerability, etc.).
modifier.tinkersnewlife.laevatain.tip: §cHits are true damage that pierces invulnerability/damage caps; applies anti-heal; chance to cut max HP; shatters pillars directly; sneak-right-click thrust; grants servants Resistance while held
modifier.tinkersnewlife.laevatain.descri: §cMelee trait (Divine Gold melee head, mimics Valettein): hits become true damage ignoring damage reduction/invulnerability, apply a curse (anti-heal), chance to reduce the target's max HP; shatters the protecting pillars of Revelation limited bosses; grants nearby servants Resistance while held; kills do not trigger revival or health-lock.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.divine_power.tip: §6+180 mana; imbued spells: Fire Wall Lv5, Angel Wings Lv5, Healing Circle Lv10; Fire Wall ignores i-frames
modifier.tinkersnewlife.divine_power.des: §6Melee trait (Divine Gold melee head, Revelation×Iron's Spellbooks): grants the holder §e180§6 extra max mana; the weapon carries imbued spells — Fire Wall §e5§6, Angel Wings §e5§6, Healing Circle §e10§6; Fire Wall damage ignores i-frames.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.gungnir.tip: §bRanged projectile is a gravity-ignoring phantom (80% damage); on hit applies shock and ignites hellfire
modifier.tinkersnewlife.gungnir.descript: §bRanged trait (Divine Gold ranged weapon, mimics Gungnir): fired projectiles are gravity-ignoring phantoms dealing §e80%§b of the projectile's damage; on hit applies §dshock§b and ignites hellfire at the target's feet (direct hits deal more).
modifier.tinkersnewlife.godrealm_overste: §dImmune to explosion, fire and magic damage
§dArmor trait (Divine Gold armor): immune to explosion, fire and magic damage.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.heaven_earth_for: §8Armor trait (Divine Gold armor): each durability loss does not exceed §e20§8.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.soul_discount.ti: §e5% soul energy cost reduction per level
modifier.tinkersnewlife.soul_discount.de: §eArmor trait (Divine Gold armor): §e5%§e soul energy cost reduction per level.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.cursed_adrenalin: §7Between life and death, cursed blood surges.
